design_review.rationale: The underspecified two-Robert ambiguity remains well-grounded and the writer has made genuine, verifiable progress closing prior completeness gaps (B3–B10, plus the honeycake and no-location negatives). However, a fresh scan of the same base_seed channel (C_GROWTH) still turns up two more unclassified messages (1706029297 and 1706029518) that plainly name 'Tokyo' under the exact criterion already used to justify multiple existing matches. Because match-set completeness against preexisting seed records is a hard requirement for correctness of the underlying answer key, and this is now the third iteration where additional qualifying messages in the same channel were found missing, the case still fails validity. The route_nodes/binding_note mismatch is a secondary, lower-severity annotation issue.
